blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Climate Change Commission (CCC) urged schools and government agencies on Tuesday to modify their schedules in anticipation of El Niño’s impact on the country. During an interview with Bagong Pilipinas Ngayon, Commissioner Albert dela Cruz proposed shifting school hours to 6:00 a.m. to 9:30 a.m. as part of local climate action […]...
